original.statement: Istio now writes a status condition on AuthorizationPolicy indicating binding to a waypoint proxy; the condition format is experimental and policies with multiple targetRefs get a single condition.

corrected.statement: Istio now writes a status condition on AuthorizationPolicy recording its binding to a waypoint proxy (status.conditions behaviour changed); the condition format is experimental and will change, and policies with multiple targetRefs receive a single condition.

decision.reason: [ev-1fd772318bb8] says Istio now writes a status condition for an AuthorizationPolicy bound to a waypoint proxy. It does not say a status.conditions field was added to the CRD schema. The CRD and rendered-diff validators were inconclusive (no snapshots), so nothing shows a schema addition. The change is better described as behavior-changed on AuthorizationPolicy status.conditions: the controller now writes a new, experimental condition.
